name: Sake Acanthus
source:
The setting is Azami High School, an ordinary school you could find anywhere.
Naoya Izumura, the sole member of the literature club, is told one day by Kazane Nogawa, his childhood friend and the student council president, that unless the club shows some results soon, it will be disbanded.
In his search for a way to save the club, he meets Himeka Sakashiro, an art club member in a similar situation. Together, they decide to collaborate on creating a picture book.
Will their artistic efforts bloom like an acanthus?

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10846]NovelGame[/url]]
